title: retrospective template variables
description: Values for templates/retrospective.md.j2 and templates/retrospective.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from retrospective.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

action_1.title: Action 1
action_1.description: The action 1 used under '(owner + due date + linked issue required)'.

attendees.title: Attendees
attendees.description: Everyone present, by name. Absences matter: an action assigned to somebody who was not in the room is an assignment, not a commitment, and it will be back next sprint.

bugs_escaped.title: Bugs escaped
bugs_escaped.description: The bugs escaped used under 'Sprint Metrics'.

commitment_ratio.title: Commitment ratio
commitment_ratio.description: The commitment ratio used under 'Sprint Metrics'.

date.title: Date
date.description: Date the session ran, ISO. Actions below have due dates measured from here, and a retro written up two weeks later is a reconstruction, not a record.

facilitator.title: Facilitator
facilitator.description: Who ran the session. Record it and rotate it - a retro facilitated by the same person every sprint quietly becomes that person's agenda with the team's names on it.

item_1.title: Item 1
item_1.description: The item 1 used under 'What Went Well'.

item_2.title: Item 2
item_2.description: The item 2 used under 'What Went Well'.

previous_action.title: Previous action
previous_action.description: The previous action used under 'Previous Action Items Review'.

retro_format.title: Retro format
retro_format.description: Which format you ran. Format shapes what surfaces - a team running one format for a year stops finding new problems and concludes it has none.

sprint_number.title: Sprint number
sprint_number.description: Which sprint this covers. Retros only compound as a series - an unnumbered one cannot be lined up against the retro where the team agreed the same action and forgot it.
